name: upbit-mcp
description: Upbit (업비트) (trading): list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles. Every tool maps to a documented endpoi

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every market as QUOTE-BASE (KRW-BTC, BTC-ETH, USDT-XRP) with Korean and English names in raw; query matches the code or either name.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: symbol is a market code such as KRW-BTC (quote first). Upbit's ticker carries no bid/ask (they are in the orderbook endpoint).

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: interval: 1m 3m 5m 10m 15m 30m 1h 4h 1d 1w 1M; up to 200 candles, newest first.
